verse.verse_1: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High,
verse.verse_5: Then turneth it to russet stubble.
verse.verse_6: We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget
verse.verse_7: Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden;
verse.verse_8: And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease.
verse.verse_9: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.
verse.verse_11: But the most hapless will flout it,
verse.verse_12: He who will be flung to the great Fire
verse.verse_13: Wherein he will neither die nor live.
verse.verse_15: And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth,
verse.verse_16: But ye prefer the life of the world
verse.verse_17: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
verse.verse_18: Lo! This is in the former scrolls.
verse.verse_19: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
